'hsl(var(--destructive))' : isWarning ? 'hsl(38 92% 50%)' : 'var(--color-primary)' return (
{Math.round(percentage)}%
{title}
{used.toLocaleString()} {unit} of {limit.toLocaleString()} {unit} used

{(limit - used).toLocaleString()} {unit} available

) }
